failure_reason: The agent committed to a flawed mental model of Python execution by assuming that inserting a new function at the top of the file would override the existing function of the same name further down. In Python, the later definition overwrites the earlier one. By giving up on removing the old `compare_authors` function, the agent's new logic was never executed, causing the author matching to fail and leading to the test failure where a new edition was created instead of matched.
